policy_name: Voice of Store Enterprise Severity Escalation Matrix

principles.separation_of_concerns: Severity reflects operational and safety risk; sentiment reflects customer emotion; actionability reflects whether specific investigative details are present.
principles.deterministic_override: Mandatory safety and allergen criteria strictly override machine-learning confidence and sentiment scores.
principles.traceability: All escalation events preserve policy version, trigger rules, matched textual evidence, and audit logs.

CRITICAL.definition: Imminent threat to human life, active physical injury, anaphylactic allergic reaction, structural failure, or biological contamination.
qualifying_conditions: Anaphylactic allergic reaction or EpiPen emergency deployment
Slip-and-fall resulting in fractures, bleeding, or emergency medical response
Active fire, dense smoke, gas leak, or exposed high-voltage wiring
Rodent, rat, or biological pest infestation on active food-preparation surfaces
Credible physical threat, weapon display, or violent altercation in store
CRITICAL.overdue_action: Automated paging to HQ Crisis Incident Commander upon SLA breach.
CRITICAL.closure_criteria: Requires dual sign-off from Store Manager and HQ Compliance Officer with signed corrective action record.

HIGH.definition: High-impact operational failure, allergen warning omissions, refrigeration temperature breaches, or gross staff misconduct.
qualifying_conditions: Pre-packaged food item missing required statutory allergen warning label
Walk-in cooler or dairy freezer temperature breach (>4°C above target) threatening perishable inventory
Past best-before or expired dairy/meat inventory found on retail display
Unattended liquid spill or floor hazard in customer walkway without safety cones
Gross staff rudeness, abusive language, or verifiable cashier misconduct
HIGH.overdue_action: Automatic escalation to Regional Operations Director at 75% SLA threshold.
HIGH.closure_criteria: Work order completion log or quarantine disposal manifest filed in Action Queue.

MEDIUM.definition: Substandard operational condition, checkout delays, pricing label discrepancies, or non-critical app payment failures.
qualifying_conditions: Card reader timeout or POS duplicate swipe error
Restroom sanitation issues, empty soap dispensers, or overflowing trash
Out of stock staple inventory or promotional flyer mismatch
Excessive checkout line delays (>10 minutes wait time during off-peak hours)
MEDIUM.overdue_action: Flagged on Daily Morning Operations Dashboard.
MEDIUM.closure_criteria: Shift supervisor resolution note in Action Queue.

LOW.definition: Minor convenience issues, shopping cart squeaks, cosmetic store fixtures, or general feedback.
qualifying_conditions: Wobbly shopping cart wheels or basket handle defects
Parking lot bay paint fading or lighting suggestions
Background music volume or mobile app visual preferences
LOW.overdue_action: Included in weekly store batch review.
LOW.closure_criteria: Closed during routine weekly maintenance sweep.
